caption:
Label your variable before any equation.

Length = 2w + 4, perimeter 50: w = 7, but the question wants the length, 18. A one-line label stops you from picking 7.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Write what your variable means first. It saves you from this trap.

youtube.title: Define Your Variable First (Avoid This SAT Trap)
youtube.description: Writing what the variable stands for keeps the setup right and stops you from answering the wrong quantity. Example: w = 7 is the width, but the length is 18.
